content: {"problemInterpretation":"The service performs a conflict check (hasConflictingSlot) and the write (createBooking) as two non-atomic steps separated by an async hook gap. Two concurrent requests can both pass the check before either commits, and booking_slots has no UNIQUE constraint to prevent duplicate (room_id, starts_at) rows. The result is double-booking stored in the database.","relevantComponents":["migrations/001_initial.sql — add UNIQUE(room_id, starts_at)","src/booking-repository.js — transactional createBooking, error handling","src/booking-service.js — propagate atomic error path","src/app.js — already maps BookingConflictError to 409, no change needed","test/booking.test.js — concurrent-regression test"],"reproductionStrategy":["Read migrations/001_initial.sql shows no UNIQUE constraint on booking_slots","Read src/booking-repository.js shows createBooking has no transaction","Read src/booking-service.js shows check, await hook, then write (racy)","Read test/booking.test.js shows no concurrent-request coverage"],"implementationApproach":["Add UNIQUE(room_id, starts_at) to booking_slots in migrations/001_initial.sql","Extract BookingConflictError into src/errors.js, importable by both repository and service","Wrap INSERT booking + INSERT slots in createBooking inside database.transaction()","Catch SQLITE_CONSTRAINT in createBooking, throw BookingConflictError","Keep hasConflictingSlot as early-exit optimization; transaction is the real guarantee","Add concurrent-regression test using afterAvailabilityCheck + Promise.all","Verify adjacent bookings and different-room bookings still succeed"],"validationPlan":["npm test must pass (existing tests)","Concurrent requests for same room+time produce one 201, one 409","Adjacent same-room bookings both succeed","Different-room same-time bookings both succeed","No duplicate (room_id, starts_at) rows in booking_slots after concurrent test"],"riskAreas":["DatabaseSync.transaction() API in Node ≥24; fallback: manual BEGIN/COMMIT","Circular dependency if BookingConflictError not extracted; mitigate via errors.js","afterAvailabilityCheck hook must remain no-op by default","SQLITE_CONSTRAINT error code may differ; catch by err.code if available"]}
